reason_definitions.ammonia_life_gas_giant_identity: The legacy substring order classifies ammonia-life gas giants as Ammonia worlds. V4 preserves their actual gas-giant identity.
reason_definitions.independent_raw_scores: Original v3.4 rank-based attenuation is absent from V4; both old stages are retained.
reason_definitions.links_require_inheritance: Geological/biological environmental links cannot create HighTech/Tourism without eligible native inheritance.
reason_definitions.local_agriculture_links: Tidal-lock/icy negatives apply to the eligible local Agriculture opportunity rather than unrelated bodies throughout the system; scoopability is excluded.
reason_definitions.local_quality_and_depth: V4 scores inherited local opportunity quality and the best four contributions instead of global capped count sums.
reason_definitions.military_stellar_inheritance: Stellar/ELW Military inheritance replaces generic landable-capacity and indirect prestige bonuses; secondary Brown Dwarfs remain independent evidence.
reason_definitions.refinery_inheritance_and_constraints: Refinery requires Rocky/Rocky-Ice inheritance. HMC workaround points and generic landability effects are removed from raw potential; usable-ground uncertainty stays in specialisation.
reason_definitions.ring_and_geological_inheritance: V4 recognises Extraction inheritance from rings (including stellar belts) and geologicals on eligible local bodies; the legacy formula used narrower global buckets.
reason_definitions.scoped_reserve_observations: V4 uses observed attached-reserve evidence only on the corresponding local body, never a broadcast system maximum or minimum.
reason_definitions.separate_exotic_evidence: Exotic stellar HighTech/Tourism support and the explicit system Tourism link remain separate from Brown-Dwarf Military and mineral-resource evidence.
reason_definitions.versioned_terraforming_state: V4 preserves the accepted canonical terraformability states and local strong-link semantics; the historical formula adapter only treated the literal Terraformable enum as candidate=true.

reference_caveats: This is a frozen-input legacy formula reference, not exported production v3.4 ratings.
Canonical fields and numerical signals are retained; only body subType comes from later API evidence.
This does not replay the historical importer: its signal parsing differs from canonical signal observations.
Null inputs remain null in retained bodies; legacy functions then apply their original false/zero defaults.
Missing attached ring evidence is unknown, then defaults to false in the legacy classifier; belts are excluded.
Distance is retained unchanged; the seven legacy economy functions do not consume weighted counts.
Legacy reserve modifiers are absent. No universal overall score is compared.
Delta and ordering flags require reviewed mechanics explanations; numerical comparison alone never certifies freeze.
review_basis: Source/contributor trace audit against the predeclared 12-system expectations and accepted V4 architecture; no claim of new expert-user acceptance.
